info.name: FinFlow - API Gateway
info.description: Gateway assertions, not a complete business API or production certification suite. See api-gateway/postman/README.md for prerequisites and coverage limits. Gateway checks and live routing run without a switch; special fixture folders skip until enabled. No real credentials are stored. Known-gap targets intentionally fail current behavior.
